ifs-lakebench: ecLand vs. ESA-CCI-Lakes LSWT

Model variables: TLWML (FLake mixed-layer temperature, the documented LSWT proxy) and AvgSurfT (skin temperature). Obs: CCI Lakes daily45 (quality flags 4-5), spatially averaged over each lake's bounding box. Metrics computed on days where both obs and model have valid values. Marker colour is TLWML bias magnitude -- click a marker to jump to that lake's detail below.
